+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.NewObject(nil, types.NewDynamicProperty(types.S, types.A)), types.S), types.B),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	authentication := input.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	methods := map[string]auth.Method{
+		"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+		"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+		"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+		"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+		"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+		"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+		"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+	}
+	method, ok := methods[string(key.Value.(ast.String))]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(key.Value.(ast.String)))
+	}
+
+	actual := authentication.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actual != nil && actual.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(method)))), nil
+}

+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	methods := map[string]auth.Method{
+		"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+		"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+		"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+		"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+		"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+		"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+		"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+	}
+
+	for name, method := range methods {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			for _, tc := range []struct {
+				code int
+				want bool
+			}{{int(method), true}, {0, false}} {
+				query := fmt.Sprintf(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, %q)`, name)
+				results, err := rego.New(rego.Query(query), rego.Input(map[string]any{
+					"authentication": map[string]any{"method": tc.code},
+				})).Eval(context.Background())
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.Len(t, results, 1)
+				require.Equal(t, tc.want, results[0].Expressions[0].Value)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+
+	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm(), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "no authentication found")
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm([2]*ast.Term{ast.StringTerm("authentication"), ast.ObjectTerm()}), ast.StringTerm("other"))
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported auth method: other")
+}
